thread:
zoe-lam: Heads-up: releasing Compliance Export for Private deployments today. Small pilot now, GA in two weeks. This gives customers a signed, tamper-evident audit bundle they can use for SOC2/HIPAA reviews. :tada:

carlos-mendez: Great. What does the bundle include?

zoe-lam: Inventory manifest, package checksums, running service config, network bindings, KMS/HSM integration summary (no private keys), and a signed attestation PDF. Optional encrypted upload to customer storage.

security-bot: Note: export requires Admin consent in the Console and verification of listed CIDR ranges. Automated PKI checks will validate chains when present.

se-team: Any CLI for air-gapped installs?

zoe-lam: Yes:

```
rwctl compliance-export --mode offline --out /tmp/rw-compliance-1797601234.zip --license <KEY>
```
deploy-bot: Rollout started at 1797601250 to us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Pilot customers get priority SE walkthrough and support.

legal-ops: Please ensure the attestation template is reviewed by Legal before wide GA.

zoe-lam: Will coordinate with Legal and Solutions Marketing for a one-pager and checklist. SEs, add pilot accounts to the tracker by 1797620000. Ping me for gaps. :thumbsup:
